frontier.hypothesis: There is a combine substitution that makes a REAL loaded value entirely unused (clause B) while the C that triggers it still carries meaning.
frontier.mechanism: combine.c:10835 needs place == 0, i.e. combine must DROP an operand rather than fold it into the consumer. Every operand-dropping simplification measured so far (+ K - K, multiply-by-zero, truncating store) is semantically vacuous; every operand-folding one rehomes the note. The open question is whether any GCC 2.7.2 simplification drops an operand for a reason that is TRUE of the data rather than true by construction.
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate the operand-deleting paths in tools/gcc-2.7.2/combine.c (simplify_binary_operation, simplify_and_const_int, make_compound_operation, simplify_comparison) and for each ask what C triggers it: e.g. an AND whose mask provably covers the loaded value's width, a shift pair that is the identity on the real data, a compare combine folds using nonzero_bits. Spell any candidate at body statements 10/11/16/38 and measure with tmp/grind/func_80030580/s8/mkpk.py + s7/runfiles.py, requiring vars>=16 at bodydiff<=4 sp=0.

frontier.hypothesis: A second folded-symbol site can be added without adding a load, lifting the frame under the s3 site law at zero byte cost.
frontier.mechanism: The site law (slots = folded-symbol sites - 1) plus this session's xb_jbase measurement (one lookup through jb = &Judge, vars=8 bodydiff=0) shows the (symbol_ref) fold survives a named base pointer. Never measured: whether replacing an existing tbl-relative read with a directly indexed read of the SAME address through the global symbol (D_8008E194[arg1*7 + 4] in one arm) adds a folded site while cse keeps the load count constant.
frontier.next_probe: Generate the D_8008E194-indexed spellings of the three arm reads and of tbl[2]/tbl[3], one site at a time and pairwise, and measure with s7/runfiles.py; accept only vars>=16 at bodydiff=0 sp=0. Note the s8 rejected forms tblidx-global-indexed-table.c and tblall-second-global-indexed.c cover the ALL-sites variants - the untested cases are the single-site and two-site ones.

frontier.hypothesis: If frontier items 1 and 2 also measure dead, the sanctioned ladder for func_80030580 is spent and the foreclosure record is complete.
frontier.mechanism: Four families died this session on top of nineteen in s8 and eight in s7; the solver axis is closed by tool verdict (H-s8-1, predicate reload1.c:2403), the permuter axis at 84k iterations in s4, and both known vars=24 routes are closed by standing Judge constraints (the volatile pad and the aggregate/self-cancel forms).
frontier.next_probe: Do NOT dispose of the function from a non-escalation modality. Work items 1 and 2 first; only an escalation-modality session should assemble the record, and it now has the full chain: the site law, the combine.c:10835 two-clause predicate, and the clause-B/T1 coincidence that explains why every byte-free carrier found so far is semantically vacuous.

judge_constraints: Restore memory/grind/func_80030580/pure-c-floor2-body.c as the chassis; the only frozen route to the target's 24 untouched locals bytes is the Phantom-frame-slot volatile pad local family in its exact sanctioned form (volatile u32 pad[N], first-decl position, // !FAKE annotation, engine allowlist row, frame forensics per .claude/rules/phantom-slot-frame-lever.md) -- measure it, do not respell the aggregate carrier.

Do not resubmit func_80030580 on any /* FAKE */ pad-local route: the phantom-frame-slot family's engine-allowlist prerequisite is owner-granted and unreachable from a grind session. Work state.json frontier item 1 -- an ordinary-C declared frame object of 13..16 bytes that no instruction touches (vars=24, bodydiff<=4, sp=0), measured on the pure-c-floor2-body.c chassis.

func_80030580 may not use a self-cancelling term in ANY spelling; work state.json frontier items 2 and 3 (cse-merged 4-site Judge form; post-reload jump2 tail-merge of real insns) or assemble the foreclosure record from an escalation-modality session.
